## AI / Robotics / Semiconductor News

- [Peak XV Partners invested $15 million](https://techcrunch.com/2026/02/15/as-ai-data-centers-hit-power-limits-peak-xv-backs-indian-startup-c2i-to-fix-the-bottleneck/) in C2i Semiconductors, which is developing integrated power delivery solutions to reduce energy losses in AI data centers as global demand surges, positioning C2i as a key player in AI infrastructure efficiency.
- [Blackstone committed up to $1.2 billion](https://techcrunch.com/2026/02/15/blackstone-backs-neysa-in-up-to-1-2b-financing-as-india-pushes-to-build-domestic-ai-infrastructure/) to Neysa, an Indian AI hardware and infrastructure startup, underscoring growing investor confidence in India's domestic AI ecosystem and its potential to influence regional market dynamics.
- [Glean raised a $150 million Series F](https://techcrunch.com/2026/02/15/the-enterprise-ai-land-grab-is-on-glean-is-building-the-layer-beneath-the-interface/) at a $7.2 billion valuation to build a model-agnostic AI infrastructure layer for enterprises, aiming to mitigate vendor lock-in and enhance large-scale AI deployment.
- [OpenAI’s CEO announced](https://techcrunch.com/2026/02/15/india-has-100m-weekly-active-chatgpt-users-sam-altman-says/) India has 100 million weekly active ChatGPT users, making it a top market for AI adoption and prompting OpenAI to expand local operations and government collaborations.
- [Peter Steinberger, creator of OpenClaw, joined OpenAI](https://techcrunch.com/2026/02/15/openclaw-creator-peter-steinberger-joins-openai/) to lead next-generation personal agent development, with OpenClaw remaining open source and supported by OpenAI, signaling a strategic push in AI-driven automation tools.
- [Baidu will integrate OpenClaw AI into its search app](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/02/15/openclaw-creator-peter-steinberger-joining-openai-altman-says.html) for 700 million users, strengthening its AI-driven search capabilities and intensifying competition in generative AI platforms.
- [Anthropic is resisting Pentagon pressure](https://techcrunch.com/2026/02/15/anthropic-and-the-pentagon-are-reportedly-arguing-over-claude-usage/) to allow military use of its Claude models, risking a $200 million defense contract and highlighting policy risks for AI firms in government markets.
- [GPU and AI accelerator supply/demand is tightening](https://techcrunch.com/2026/02/15/gpu-and-ai-accelerator-supply-demand-tightens-amid-rising-enterprise-ai-adoption/) amid rising enterprise AI adoption, driving increased investment and competition in AI hardware and impacting future market positioning.
- [Hardware startups in semiconductors and chip design secured major funding rounds](https://techcrunch.com/2026/02/15/hardware-startups-in-semiconductors-and-chip-design-secure-major-funding-rounds/), reflecting strong investor interest in advanced hardware and signaling potential for technological breakthroughs in the semiconductor sector.
- [Robotics and automation companies are seeing increased funding](https://techcrunch.com/2026/02/15/robotics-and-automation-companies-see-increased-funding-as-industrial-automation-accelerates/) as industrial automation accelerates, indicating robust investor confidence and growth potential in robotics and AI markets.
- [A surge in robotics IPOs and M&A activity](https://techcrunch.com/2026/02/15/robotech-ipos-and-ma-activity-reflect-growing-confidence-in-automation-technologies/) reflects growing investor confidence in automation technologies and a competitive landscape driven by breakthroughs in robotics and AI.
- [AI company funding rounds highlight rising valuations and strategic investor interest](https://techcrunch.com/2026/02/15/ai-company-funding-rounds-highlight-growing-valuations-and-strategic-investor-interest/), underscoring the expanding market size and importance of AI infrastructure for future investment opportunities.
- [AI regulation and policy changes under consideration](https://techcrunch.com/2026/02/15/ai-regulation-and-policy-changes-under-consideration-could-impact-enterprise-ai-deployments/) could significantly impact enterprise AI deployments, emphasizing the need for investors to monitor evolving governance and its effects on market dynamics.
- [ByteDance launched Doubao-Seed-2.0 AI model](https://www.caixinglobal.com/2026-02-15/bytedance-unveils-doubao-20-ai-model-to-tackle-complex-tasks-102414865.html) to tackle complex tasks and strengthen multimodal reasoning, signaling a technical breakthrough and intensifying competition with Tencent, Alibaba, and Ant Group.
- [Endong Medical completed angel round financing](https://36kr.com/p/3681628242980741) to advance embodied intelligence and minimally invasive surgical devices, securing exclusive 20-year patent rights and strengthening its position in medical robotics.
- [Zhongke Yixiang completed a multi-million yuan Series A](https://36kr.com/p/3681333437247106) to develop advanced brain-computer interface technology, positioning itself as a potential leader in neurotechnology and AI-driven medical devices.
- [The India AI Impact Summit will feature top tech CEOs](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/02/16/india-ai-impact-summit-tech-ceos-new-delhi.html), highlighting India’s strategic importance as a high-growth AI market and potential hub for global investment and innovation.
- [Rivian’s 2025 earnings and Volkswagen JV](https://techcrunch.com/2026/02/15/techcrunch-mobility-rivians-savior/) underscore the critical role of software and cost reduction in its recovery, with a 27% stock jump and broader implications for EV and autonomous vehicle supply chains.
